extracted.name: Fish or Chicken Piccata
extracted.description: You can use either protein in this recipe. Remember that the fish will cook more quickly. I like to use margarine for a dairy free dish.
ingredient_lines: 4 chicken breasts pounded thin or white fish such as sole
4 tablespoons unsalted butter or use margarine if dairy free
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400. Season protein with salt and dip both sides in flour. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter (or margarine) to large skillet over medium high heat. Add protein, flipping when edges brown. Remove and place in oven safe platter.

Add capers and garlic to pan, reduce heat to medium stir for 20 seconds. Add chicken stock and lemon juice, stir and scrape up bits. Let simmer for 2 minutes, then add remaining butter (or margarine) and Italian seasoning. Spoon over protein and finish in oven until to correct temperature.
